summary: Interface-bound retreat of existing annotated immune infiltrate into stroma.

rules.claim: Every changed pixel converts Immune infiltrate to Stroma and no unrelated label changes.
rules.required_observation: Compare source and target masks pixelwise.
counterexamples: Deleting immune infiltrate into background or tumor.

rules.claim: The change starts from a real selected Stroma/Immune interface and passes full area, topology and boundary gates.
counterexamples: Erasing a remote immune component without adjacent stroma.
